_note: BTC HTLC leg config. feeAddress is a PUBLIC receiving address for the 0.1% protocol settlement fee (taken ONLY on redeem, never on refund — see ../PROTOCOL.md §5). No private keys live here or anywhere in the repo. The HTLC is non-custodial: only the receiver (with the preimage) or the depositor (after the CLTV timelock) can move a locked output; the relay never can.
_hashNote: Hashlock H = sha256(preimage), byte-identical to the EVM and Solana legs. Script uses OP_SHA256 (NOT OP_HASH160) so the on-chain hashlock equals the shared protocol H.

mainnet.label: Bitcoin mainnet (GATED — requires mainnet_enabled=true + legal review)

timelockDefaults._note: BTC uses nLockTime. Unix-time CLTV (>=500000000) pairs naturally with EVM/Solana timestamp legs. As the shared/long (maker, T1) side use ~24h; as the short (taker, T2) side use ~12h. Enforce T2 < T1 per PROTOCOL.md §3.
